title: Seller identity and complaints
description: Does the store say who sells: a legal name, a geographic address, an email address, and the registration and tax numbers its markets require?

title: Privacy notices and choices
description: Is a privacy notice linked from the home page, does it name a privacy contact, and are the opt-out links and signals of the store's markets in place before any tracking starts?

title: Withdrawal, returns and cancellation
description: Can a consumer find how to withdraw, return or cancel: the EU withdrawal function, Argentina's withdrawal button, the statutory return period and an online cancellation route for subscriptions?

title: Accessibility
description: Is an accessibility statement linked, and do the pages read pass the accessibility basics a static scan can check? Automated checks find a minority of barriers and never show conformance.

title: Product and price information
description: Do product pages name the manufacturer and the EU responsible person, do discounts show the prior price, are reviews explained and environmental claims specific?

title: AI transparency and content rights
description: Is an AI assistant on the site, is text and data mining reserved in a machine-readable way that does not also shut out shopping agents, and are AI-generated images marked?
